AI.translation: 音频-视频表示学习的最新进展表明了结合对比对齐与掩码重构的价值。然而，在单次前向传播中联合优化这些目标，迫使对比分支依赖于为重构而设计的随机可见块，而非跨模态对齐，从而引入了语义噪声和优化干扰。我们提出了TG-DP，一个教师引导的双路径框架，将重构和对齐解耦为独立的优化路径。通过解开两个分支的遮蔽机制，TG-DP使对比路径能够使用更适合跨模态对齐的可见模式。教师模型进一步为该分支中可见Token的组织提供了辅助指导，有助于减少干扰并稳定跨模态表示学习。TG-DP在零样本检索中实现了最先进的性能。在AudioSet上，它将视频到音频检索的R@1从35.2%提高到37.4%，音频到视频检索从27.9%提高到37.1%。学到的表示也保持了语义鲁棒性，在AS20K和VGGSound上实现了最先进的线性探测性能。总而言之，我们的结果表明，解耦多模态目标并将教师引导结构引入对比路径为改进大规模音频-视频预训练提供了一个有效的框架。代码可在https://github.com/wanglg20/TG-DP获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为TG-DP的音频-视频表示学习框架，旨在解决联合优化重构与对齐任务时产生的语义噪声问题。通过将这两个任务解耦至独立的双路径中，并利用教师模型引导对比路径中的Token组织，该方法显著提升了跨模态表示学习的稳健性和准确性。
AI.keywords: 音频-视频表示学习, 语义噪声减少, 教师引导, 解耦优化, 跨模态对齐
AI.comments: 该论文通过解耦多模态学习任务（重构与对齐）并引入教师引导机制，巧妙解决了联合优化带来的语义噪声和干扰问题。这是一种非常具有启发性的设计，特别是在处理大规模音频-视频预训练任务时，通过改变遮蔽策略来提升跨模态对齐效果的方法具有很高的实用价值。

title: Clickbait detection: quick inference with maximum impact
summary: We propose a lightweight hybrid approach to clickbait detection that combines OpenAI semantic embeddings with six compact heuristic features capturing stylistic and informational cues. To improve efficiency, embeddings are reduced using PCA and evaluated with XGBoost, GraphSAGE, and GCN classifiers. While the simplified feature design yields slightly lower F1-scores, graph-based models achieve competitive performance with substantially reduced inference time. High ROC--AUC values further indicate strong discrimination capability, supporting reliable detection of clickbait headlines under varying decision thresholds.

AI.title_translation: 点击诱饵检测：以最大影响力实现快速推理
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合语义嵌入与图神经网络的轻量级点击诱饵检测方法，在显著提升推理速度的同时保持了高性能。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决现有点击诱饵检测方法在推理效率上的不足，寻求在保持检测效果的前提下实现快速推理。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合方法：利用OpenAI语义嵌入结合六种启发式特征；使用PCA进行降维；并对比评估了XGBoost、GraphSAGE和GCN分类器的性能。
AI.result: 尽管简化特征设计导致F1分数略有下降，但基于图的模型（GraphSAGE和GCN）在显著降低推理时间的同时实现了竞争性的性能，且ROC-AUC值显示出强大的区分能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了轻量级混合方法在保持强区分能力的同时，能显著缩短点击诱饵检测的推理时间，适用于高性能要求的实际场景。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于点击诱饵检测的轻量级混合方法，它结合了 OpenAI 的语义嵌入与六种捕捉风格和信息线索的紧凑启发式特征。为了提高效率，我们使用 PCA 对嵌入进行了降维，并使用 XGBoost、GraphSAGE 和 GCN 分类器进行了评估。虽然简化的特征设计导致 F1 分数略有下降，但基于图的模型在显著缩短推理时间的同时实现了具有竞争力的性能。高 ROC-AUC 值进一步表明其具有强大的判别能力，支持在不同决策阈值下可靠地检测点击诱饵标题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合语义嵌入与启发式特征的轻量级点击诱饵检测方法。通过PCA降维并利用图神经网络（GraphSAGE和GCN）进行分类，该方法在牺牲少量F1分数的情况下，大幅提升了推理速度，并保持了良好的区分能力。
AI.keywords: 点击诱饵检测, 语义嵌入, 图神经网络, 推理效率, 特征工程
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于平衡了检测性能与推理效率，通过结合语义嵌入与启发式特征，并引入图神经网络，为实时点击诱饵检测提供了一种轻量级方案。局限性在于简化特征导致了F1分数的轻微下降，但其在推理速度上的提升具有很高的实际应用价值。

title: A Direct Approach for Handling Contextual Bandits with Latent State Dynamics
summary: We revisit the finite-armed linear bandit model by Nelson et al. (2022), where contexts and rewards are governed by a finite hidden Markov chain. Nelson et al. (2022) approach this model by a reduction to linear contextual bandits; but to do so, they actually introduce a simplification in which rewards are linear functions of the posterior probabilities over the hidden states given the observed contexts, rather than functions of the hidden states themselves. Their analysis (but not their algorithm) also does not take into account the estimation of the HMM parameters, and only tackles expected, not high-probability, bounds, which suffer in addition from unnecessary complex dependencies on the model (like reward gaps). We instead study the more natural model incorporating direct dependencies in the hidden states (on top of dependencies on the observed contexts, as is natural for contextual bandits) and also obtain stronger, high-probability, regret bounds for a fully adaptive strategy that estimates HMM parameters online. These bounds do not depend on the reward functions and only depend on the model through the estimation of the HMM parameters.

AI.title_translation: 一种处理具有隐状态动态的上下文老虎机的直接方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种直接建模隐状态动态的上下文老虎机算法，通过在线估计HMM参数，获得了不依赖于奖励函数的高概率后悔界。
AI.motivation: 针对现有研究在处理具有隐状态动态的上下文老虎机问题时，存在对奖励函数假设过于简化、忽视参数估计过程以及后悔界依赖于奖励间隙等问题，旨在提出一种更自然、更强鲁棒性的处理方法。
AI.method: 提出一种直接处理隐状态依赖关系的策略，通过在线估计隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）参数，并推导出不依赖于奖励函数的高概率后悔界。
AI.result: 成功推导出了强高概率后悔界，该界限不依赖于奖励函数，仅与HMM参数估计的误差相关，实现了完全自适应的在线策略。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种针对具有隐状态动态的上下文老虎机问题的直接处理方法，实现了无需依赖奖励函数性质的强高概率后悔界，完善了该领域的理论框架。
AI.translation: 我们重新审视了Nelson等人（2022）提出的有限臂线性老虎机模型，在该模型中，上下文和奖励由一个有限隐马尔可夫链控制。Nelson等人将此模型简化为线性上下文老虎机，但他们引入了简化假设：奖励是给定观测上下文后隐状态后验概率的线性函数，而非直接关于隐状态的函数。此外，他们的分析（而非算法）未考虑HMM参数的估计，且仅处理了期望后悔界而非高概率后悔界，这些界限还受到模型依赖（如奖励间隙）的复杂影响。相反，我们研究了更自然的模型，该模型纳入了隐状态的直接依赖关系（在上下文依赖之上），并为一种在线估计HMM参数的完全自适应策略获得了更强的高概率后悔界。这些界限不依赖于奖励函数，仅通过HMM参数估计来体现模型的影响。
AI.summary: 本文针对带有隐马尔可夫链状态动态的有限臂线性老虎机模型，提出了一种直接处理方法。相比以往将问题简化为基于后验概率的线性模型，本文方法直接建模隐状态与奖励的依赖关系，并实现了HMM参数的在线估计，从而获得了更优且不依赖于奖励函数的高概率后悔界。
AI.keywords: 上下文老虎机, 隐马尔可夫模型, 后悔界, 在线参数估计
AI.comments: 该研究通过直接处理隐状态依赖关系，克服了前人研究中简化模型假设及依赖奖励间隙的局限性，在理论上取得了更强的后悔界，具有显著的理论贡献。

title: Semantic-Aware UAV Command and Control for Efficient IoT Data Collection
comments: Accepted for publication at the IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP)
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have emerged as a key enabler technology for data collection from Internet of Things (IoT) devices. However, effective data collection is challenged by resource constraints and the need for real-time decision-making. In this work, we propose a novel framework that integrates semantic communication with UAV command-and-control (C&C) to enable efficient image data collection from IoT devices. Each device uses Deep Joint Source-Channel Coding (DeepJSCC) to generate a compact semantic latent representation of its image to enable image reconstruction even under partial transmission. A base station (BS) controls the UAV's trajectory by transmitting acceleration commands. The objective is to maximize the average quality of reconstructed images by maintaining proximity to each device for a sufficient duration within a fixed time horizon. To address the challenging trade-off and account for delayed C&C signals, we model the problem as a Markov Decision Process and propose a Double Deep Q-Learning (DDQN)-based adaptive flight policy. Simulation results show that our approach outperforms baseline methods such as greedy and traveling salesman algorithms, in both device coverage and semantic reconstruction quality.
comment: Accepted for publication at the IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP)

AI.title_translation: 用于高效物联网数据采集的语义感知无人机指挥与控制
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合语义通信与DDQN策略的无人机框架，实现了资源受限下高效的物联网图像数据采集与高质量重建。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决无人机在物联网数据采集过程中面临的资源受限及实时决策挑战，以提升大规模图像数据的采集效率和重建质量。
AI.method: 提出了一种集成语义通信的无人机指挥控制框架，使用DeepJSCC对图像进行语义编码，并利用基于双深度Q学习（DDQN）的自适应飞行策略来控制无人机轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该方法在设备覆盖率和语义重建质量方面均优于贪婪算法和旅行商问题（TSP）算法等基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语义通信与DDQN结合，该框架能有效优化无人机轨迹，显著提升了IoT图像数据的采集效率和重建质量。
AI.translation: 无人机（UAV）已成为从物联网（IoT）设备收集数据的关键赋能技术。然而，有效的数据收集受到资源限制和实时决策需求的挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个新颖的框架，将语义通信与无人机指挥与控制（C&C）相结合，以实现从物联网设备收集高效的图像数据。每个设备使用深度联合信源信道编码（DeepJSCC）来生成其图像的紧凑语义潜在表示，即使在部分传输下也能实现图像重建。基站（BS）通过传输加速度指令来控制无人机的轨迹。目标是通过在固定时间范围内与每个设备保持足够的接近距离，最大化重建图像的平均质量。为了解决这一具有挑战性的权衡并考虑延迟的C&C信号，我们将该问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并提出了一种基于双深度Q学习（DDQN）的自适应飞行策略。仿真结果表明，我们的方法在设备覆盖率和语义重建质量方面均优于贪婪算法和旅行商算法等基准方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合语义通信与无人机指挥控制的物联网数据采集框架。通过DeepJSCC对图像进行紧凑语义表示，并利用DDQN算法优化无人机飞行轨迹，从而在资源受限的情况下最大化图像重建质量。
AI.keywords: 无人机, 语义通信, 物联网, 深度强化学习, 数据采集
AI.comments: 该研究将语义通信与无人机路径规划相结合，创新性地利用DeepJSCC处理图像数据，有效解决了资源受限环境下的数据采集难题，具有很高的实际应用价值。

title: Training Data Size Sensitivity in Unsupervised Rhyme Recognition
summary: Rhyme is deceptively intuitive: what is or is not a rhyme is constructed historically, scholars struggle with rhyme classification, and people disagree on whether two words are rhymed or not. This complicates automated rhymed recognition and evaluation, especially in multilingual context. This article investigates how much training data is needed for reliable unsupervised rhyme recognition using RhymeTagger, a language-independent tool that identifies rhymes based on repeating patterns in poetry corpora. We evaluate its performance across seven languages (Czech, German, English, French, Italian, Russian, and Slovene), examining how training size and language differences affect accuracy. To set a realistic performance benchmark, we assess inter-annotator agreement on a manually annotated subset of poems and analyze factors contributing to disagreement in expert annotations: phonetic similarity between rhyming words and their distance from each other in a poem. We also compare RhymeTagger to three large language models using a one-shot learning strategy. Our findings show that, once provided with sufficient training data, RhymeTagger consistently outperforms human agreement, while LLMs lacking phonetic representation significantly struggle with the task.

AI.title_translation: 无监督押韵识别中训练数据规模的敏感性
AI.tldr: 研究表明，在充足的训练数据支持下，专门的押韵识别工具RhymeTagger的表现优于人类专家，且显著强于缺乏音韵处理能力的大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 押韵的定义具有历史和主观复杂性，导致自动化押韵识别困难，尤其是在多语言环境下。作者旨在探究实现可靠无监督押韵识别所需的最小训练数据量，并评估现有工具与大语言模型的性能差异。
AI.method: 使用RhymeTagger工具，针对七种语言的诗歌语料库进行实验，分析训练数据规模对识别准确率的影响；通过评估专家标注的一致性设立基准，并与采用一次性学习（one-shot learning）策略的三种大语言模型进行对比。
AI.result: RhymeTagger在获得足够训练数据后表现稳定，准确率优于人类标注者；相比之下，缺乏音韵表征的大语言模型在识别押韵方面表现较差。研究还指出，语音相似度和诗句间距是影响人类判断分歧的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 在拥有足够训练数据的情况下，RhymeTagger能够实现可靠的无监督押韵识别，其性能甚至超过人类专家的一致性，而缺乏音韵表征的LLM在该任务上表现不佳。
AI.translation: 押韵看似直观，但其定义具有历史构建性，学者们在押韵分类上存在分歧，且人们对两个词是否押韵往往观点不一。这使得自动化押韵识别和评估变得复杂，尤其是在多语言背景下。本文研究了使用RhymeTagger进行可靠的无监督押韵识别所需的训练数据量，该工具是一种基于诗歌语料库中重复模式来识别押韵的独立于语言的工具。我们评估了它在七种语言（捷克语、德语、英语、法语、意大利语、俄语和斯洛文尼亚语）中的表现，检查了训练规模和语言差异如何影响准确性。为了设定现实的性能基准，我们评估了人工标注诗歌子集上的标注者间一致性，并分析了导致专家标注分歧的因素：押韵词之间的语音相似性及其在诗歌中的距离。我们还将RhymeTagger与三种采用一次性学习策略的大语言模型进行了比较。研究结果表明，一旦提供了足够的训练数据，RhymeTagger的表现始终优于人类的一致性，而缺乏语音表征的大语言模型在该任务上表现吃力。
AI.summary: 本文研究了无监督押韵识别中训练数据规模的影响，评估了RhymeTagger在七种语言诗歌中的表现。结果表明，充足的训练数据使RhymeTagger的准确率超过了人类专家，且优于缺乏音韵表征的大语言模型。
AI.keywords: 押韵识别, 无监督学习, 训练数据规模, 音韵表征, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究通过量化训练数据量对无监督押韵识别的影响，揭示了领域特定工具（如RhymeTagger）在押韵识别任务上优于通用大语言模型（LLM）的现象，强调了音韵表征在语言处理任务中的重要性。其局限性在于主要依赖重复模式，可能难以处理复杂的非重复性押韵。

title: State-Flow Coordinated Representation for MI-EEG Decoding
summary: Motor Imagery (MI) Electroencephalography (EEG) signals contain two crucial and complementary types of information: state information, which captures the global context of the task, and flow information, which captures fine-grained temporal dynamics. However, existing deep decoding models typically focus on only one of these information streams, resulting in unstable learning and sub-optimal performance. To address this, we propose the State-Flow Coordinated Network (StaFlowNet), a novel architecture that explicitly separates and coordinates state and flow information. We first employ a dual-branch design to extract the global state vector and temporal flow features separately. Critically, a novel state-modulated flow module is proposed to dynamically refine the learning of flow information. This modulated mechanism effectively integrates global context with fine-grained dynamics, thereby significantly enhancing task discriminability and decoding performance. Experiments on three public MI-EEG datasets demonstrate that StaFlowNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies further confirm that the state-modulated mechanism plays a crucial role in enhancing feature discriminability and overall performance.

AI.title_translation: 用于MI-EEG解码的状态-流协同表征
AI.tldr: StaFlowNet通过显式分离并协同全局状态与时序流动信息，显著提升了运动想象EEG信号的解码性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度解码模型通常只关注状态信息或流动信息中的一种，导致学习过程不稳定且性能难以达到最优。
AI.method: 提出StaFlowNet架构，采用双分支设计分别提取全局状态向量和时序流动特征，并引入状态调制流动模块（state-modulated flow module）将全局上下文动态整合到细粒度时序特征中。
AI.result: 在三个公开MI-EEG数据集上的实验表明，StaFlowNet的性能显著优于当前最先进的方法；消融实验证实了状态调制机制对提升特征可分性和整体性能的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: StaFlowNet通过显式分离并协调状态与流动信息，有效提升了MI-EEG的解码精度，证明了该协同机制在处理复杂时序脑电信号中的重要性。
AI.translation: 运动想象（MI）脑电图（EEG）信号包含两种关键且互补的信息：捕捉任务全局上下文的状态信息，以及捕捉细粒度时序动态的流动信息。然而，现有的深度解码模型通常只关注其中一种信息流，导致学习不稳定且性能欠佳。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了状态-流协同网络（StaFlowNet），这是一种显式分离并协调状态和流动信息的新型架构。我们首先采用双分支设计分别提取全局状态向量和时序流动特征。关键在于，我们提出了一种新颖的状态调制流动模块，用于动态优化流动信息的学习。这种调制机制有效地将全局上下文与细粒度动态相结合，从而显著增强了任务的可分性和解码性能。在三个公共MI-EEG数据集上的实验表明，StaFlowNet显著优于当前最先进的方法。消融研究进一步证实，状态调制机制在增强特征可分性和整体性能方面发挥了至关重要的作用。
AI.summary: 本文针对MI-EEG信号解码中信息利用不充分的问题，提出了一种名为StaFlowNet的新型架构。该模型通过双分支结构分别提取全局状态和时序流动特征，并利用创新的状态调制模块实现两者的动态融合，从而显著增强了模型的解码性能。
AI.keywords: 运动想象, 脑电图, 状态流协同, 深度学习, 解码模型
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将MI-EEG信号分解为全局状态（state）和时序流动（flow）信息，并设计了状态调制机制来融合两者，解决了传统模型信息利用单一的问题。其设计逻辑清晰，在多个数据集上验证了有效性，为EEG解码提供了新的视角。

title: Face-D(^2)CL: Multi-Domain Synergistic Representation with Dual Continual Learning for Facial DeepFake Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of facial forgery techniques poses severe threats to public trust and information security, making facial DeepFake detection a critical research priority. Continual learning provides an effective approach to adapt facial DeepFake detection models to evolving forgery patterns. However, existing methods face two key bottlenecks in real-world continual learning scenarios: insufficient feature representation and catastrophic forgetting. To address these issues, we propose Face-D(^2)CL, a framework for facial DeepFake detection. It leverages multi-domain synergistic representation to fuse spatial and frequency-domain features for the comprehensive capture of diverse forgery traces, and employs a dual continual learning mechanism that combines Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which distinguishes parameter importance for real versus fake samples, and Orthogonal Gradient Constraint (OGC), which ensures updates to task-specific adapters do not interfere with previously learned knowledge. This synergy enables the model to achieve a dynamic balance between robust anti-forgetting capabilities and agile adaptability to emerging facial forgery paradigms, all without relying on historical data replay. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method surpasses current SOTA approaches in both stability and plasticity, achieving 60.7% relative reduction in average detection error rate, respectively. On unseen forgery domains, it further improves the average detection AUC by 7.9% compared to the current SOTA method.

AI.title_translation: Face-D(^2)CL：用于人脸DeepFake检测的多域协同表示与双重持续学习方法
AI.tldr: Face-D(^2)CL通过多域特征融合与双重持续学习策略，在无需历史数据的情况下，显著提升了DeepFake检测模型在动态环境下的稳健性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的DeepFake检测模型在面对不断演进的伪造技术时，存在特征表示不足以及严重的灾难性遗忘问题，难以适应真实场景下的持续学习需求。
AI.method: 提出了Face-D(^2)CL框架，采用多域协同表示融合空间与频域特征；引入双重持续学习机制，结合弹性权重巩固（EWC）区分参数重要性，并使用正交梯度约束（OGC）保护已学知识，实现了无需历史数据重放的模型更新。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法优于当前SOTA方法，平均检测错误率降低了60.7%，在未见过的伪造域上，平均检测AUC提升了7.9%。
AI.conclusion: Face-D(^2)CL通过多域协同表示与双重持续学习机制，有效提升了DeepFake检测模型在不断演进的伪造技术面前的稳定性和适应性，无需依赖历史数据重放。
AI.translation: 人脸伪造技术的快速发展对公众信任和信息安全构成了严重威胁，使得人脸DeepFake检测成为一个关键的研究重点。持续学习提供了一种有效的方法来使人脸DeepFake检测模型适应不断演变的伪造模式。然而，现有方法在现实世界的持续学习场景中面临两个关键瓶颈：特征表示不足和灾难性遗忘。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Face-D(^2)CL，一个用于人脸DeepFake检测的框架。它利用多域协同表示来融合空间和频域特征，以全面捕捉各种伪造痕迹，并采用双重持续学习机制，结合了区分真实样本与伪造样本参数重要性的弹性权重巩固（EWC），以及确保任务特定适配器的更新不会干扰先前学习知识的正交梯度约束（OGC）。这种协同作用使模型能够在不依赖历史数据重放的情况下，在强大的抗遗忘能力和对新兴人脸伪造范式的敏捷适应性之间实现动态平衡。大量实验证明，我们的方法在稳定性和可塑性方面均超过了当前的SOTA方法，平均检测错误率分别降低了60.7%。在未见过的伪造领域，与当前的SOTA方法相比，它进一步将平均检测AUC提高了7.9%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Face-D(^2)CL的DeepFake检测框架。该框架通过融合空间与频域特征以获取多域协同表示，并利用结合了EWC和OGC的双重持续学习机制，在无需历史数据重放的情况下，有效平衡了模型的抗遗忘能力与对新伪造模式的适应能力。
AI.keywords: DeepFake检测, 持续学习, 多域协同表示, 灾难性遗忘, 弹性权重巩固
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个创新的双重持续学习框架，旨在解决DeepFake检测中常见的灾难性遗忘问题，且无需重放历史数据，这在隐私敏感场景下具有很高的应用价值。其方法巧妙结合了空间与频域特征，为模型提供了更全面的伪造追踪能力。

title: Shift- and stretch-invariant non-negative matrix factorization with an application to brain tissue delineation in emission tomography data
summary: Dynamic neuroimaging data, such as emission tomography measurements of radiotracer transport in blood or cerebrospinal fluid, often exhibit diffusion-like properties. These introduce distance-dependent temporal delays, scale-differences, and stretching effects that limit the effectiveness of conventional linear modeling and decomposition methods. To address this, we present the shift- and stretch-invariant non-negative matrix factorization framework. Our approach estimates both integer and non-integer temporal shifts as well as temporal stretching, all implemented in the frequency domain, where shifts correspond to phase modifications, and where stretching is handled via zero-padding or truncation. The model is implemented in PyTorch (https://github.com/anders-s-olsen/shiftstretchNMF). We demonstrate on synthetic data and brain emission tomography data that the model is able to account for stretching to provide more detailed characterization of brain tissue structure.

AI.title_translation: 平移和拉伸不变非负矩阵分解及其在发射断层扫描数据脑组织界定中的应用
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的NMF框架，通过在频域处理时间平移和拉伸，有效解决了动态神经影像数据中的非线性延迟问题，提升了组织结构表征精度。
AI.motivation: 动态神经影像数据（如发射断层扫描）中存在的扩散特性会导致时间延迟、尺度差异和拉伸效应，导致传统的线性建模和分解方法效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出了一种平移和拉伸不变的非负矩阵分解（NMF）框架。该方法在频域中实现，利用相位修改处理时间平移，并通过零填充或截断处理时间拉伸，并基于PyTorch进行了实现。
AI.result: 在合成数据和脑部发射断层扫描数据上的实验表明，该模型能够有效处理拉伸效应，从而实现对脑组织结构的更详细表征。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的平移和拉伸不变NMF框架能够有效克服传统线性建模在处理具有扩散特性数据时的局限性，为脑组织结构的精细表征提供了一种稳健的工具。
AI.translation: 动态神经影像数据（如血液或脑脊液中放射性示踪剂传输的发射断层扫描测量）通常表现出类似扩散的特性。这引入了与距离相关的时间延迟、尺度差异和拉伸效应，限制了传统线性建模和分解方法的有效性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了平移和拉伸不变的非负矩阵分解框架。我们的方法在频域中估计整数和非整数的时间平移以及时间拉伸，其中平移对应于相位修改，而拉伸通过零填充或截断来处理。该模型在PyTorch中实现（https://github.com/anders-s-olsen/shiftstretchNMF）。我们在合成数据和脑部发射断层扫描数据上证明，该模型能够处理拉伸，从而提供脑组织结构的更详细表征。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于动态神经影像数据的平移和拉伸不变非负矩阵分解框架。通过在频域内处理时间平移和拉伸，该模型解决了传统方法难以应对的数据扩散特性问题，并在脑组织结构表征任务中表现出优越性。
AI.keywords: 非负矩阵分解, 动态神经影像, 频域分析, 组织结构表征, 平移拉伸不变性
AI.comments: 该研究针对动态神经影像数据中常见的非线性时间延迟和拉伸问题，提出了一种创新的频域处理框架。通过将平移和拉伸纳入非负矩阵分解（NMF），该方法显著提升了对复杂生物医学数据结构表征的能力，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Bayesian Tendon Breakage Localization under Model Uncertainty Using Distributed Fiber Optic Sensors
summary: This study develops a Bayesian, uncertainty-aware framework for tendon breakage localization in pre-stressed concrete members using high-resolution data from distributed fiber-optic sensors (DFOS). DFOS enable full-field monitoring of strain changes on the surface of pre-stressed concrete members due to such failure. A finite element model (FEM) of an experimental tendon-breakage test is constructed, and model parameters are calibrated probabilistically against DFOS measurements. To capture model-form uncertainty (MFU), stochastic perturbations are embedded directly into material parameters, enabling the joint inference of physical properties and MFU within a unified probabilistic framework. Gaussian Process surrogates are employed to efficiently emulate the nonlinear FEM response, supporting computationally tractable Bayesian inference. A $φ$-divergence-based influence analysis identifies the DFOS measurements that most strongly shape the posterior distributions, providing interpretable diagnostics of sensor informativeness and model adequacy. The calibrated parameters and embedded uncertainties are then transferred to a FEM of a full-scale structural configuration, enabling prediction of tendon breakage localization under realistic conditions. A separability analysis of the predictive strain distributions quantifies the identifiability of tendon breakage at varying depths, assessing the confidence with which different damage scenarios can be distinguished given the propagated uncertainties. Results demonstrate that the framework achieves robust parameter calibration, interpretable diagnostics, and uncertainty-informed damage detection, integrating experimental data, embedded MFU, and probabilistic modeling. By systematically propagating both experimental and model uncertainties, the approach supports reliable tendon breakage localization and optimal DFOS placement.

AI.title_translation: 基于模型不确定性的分布式光纤传感预应力筋断裂贝叶斯定位研究
AI.tldr: 提出了一种集成了模型不确定性与高斯过程代理模型的贝叶斯框架，实现了利用分布式光纤传感器对预应力筋断裂的鲁棒定位与可解释性监测。
AI.motivation: 针对预应力混凝土结构中预应力筋断裂定位问题，现有方法往往忽略模型形式不确定性，导致监测结果不可靠，因此需要开发一种能够系统化考虑不确定性的贝叶斯监测框架。
AI.method: 构建有限元模型并进行概率校准；利用随机扰动嵌入模型形式不确定性（MFU）；采用高斯过程代理模型加速计算；使用基于phi-divergence的影响分析评估传感器信息量；通过可分性分析评估断裂识别的置信度。
AI.result: 框架实现了稳健的参数校准与断裂定位；通过影响分析提供了传感器诊断；量化了不同深度下断裂识别的置信度，证明了该方法在处理实验数据与模型不确定性集成方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了一个能够稳健量化不确定性的贝叶斯框架，实现了在模型不确定性存在下的预应力筋断裂定位，为实际工程结构监测提供了可靠的理论与方法支持。
AI.translation: 本研究开发了一种基于贝叶斯的、具备不确定性感知能力的框架，用于利用分布式光纤传感器（DFOS）的高分辨率数据对预应力混凝土构件中的预应力筋断裂进行定位。DFOS能够实现对预应力混凝土构件因断裂引起的表面应变变化的全面监测。研究构建了预应力筋断裂实验的有限元模型（FEM），并针对DFOS测量数据对模型参数进行了概率校准。为了捕捉模型形式不确定性（MFU），将随机扰动直接嵌入材料参数中，从而在一个统一的概率框架内实现物理属性和MFU的联合推断。采用高斯过程代理模型来高效模拟非线性FEM响应，支持计算上可行的贝叶斯推断。一种基于phi-divergence的影响分析方法识别出对后验分布影响最大的DFOS测量值，为传感器信息量和模型充分性提供了可解释的诊断。随后，将校准后的参数和嵌入的不确定性传递到全尺寸结构配置的FEM中，实现了真实条件下预应力筋断裂定位的预测。通过对预测应变分布的可分性分析，量化了不同深度下预应力筋断裂的可识别性，评估了在传播不确定性的前提下区分不同损伤场景的置信度。结果表明，该框架实现了稳健的参数校准、可解释的诊断以及基于不确定性的损伤检测，有效集成了实验数据、嵌入式MFU和概率建模。通过系统地传播实验和模型不确定性，该方法支持可靠的预应力筋断裂定位和DFOS的最优布置。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯框架的预应力筋断裂定位方法，利用分布式光纤传感器（DFOS）数据，通过集成模型形式不确定性（MFU）和高斯过程代理模型，实现了对预应力混凝土结构损伤的鲁棒性识别与诊断，并系统评估了监测数据的可分性。
AI.keywords: 预应力筋断裂定位, 分布式光纤传感器, 贝叶斯推断, 模型不确定性, 高斯过程代理模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将贝叶斯推断与高斯过程代理模型结合，有效解决了复杂结构监测中模型不确定性（MFU）的量化难题。通过phi-divergence影响分析，实现了传感器信息量的可解释性诊断，为结构健康监测提供了稳健的概率框架。局限性在于对高斯过程代理模型的依赖，其精度可能限制了在极端非线性工况下的表现。

title: T-Gated Adapter: A Lightweight Temporal Adapter for Vision-Language Medical Segmentation
comments: Accepted at the PHAROS-AIF-MIH Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Medical image segmentation traditionally relies on fully supervised 3D architectures that demand a large amount of dense, voxel-level annotations from clinical experts which is a prohibitively expensive process. Vision Language Models (VLMs) offer a powerful alternative by leveraging broad visual semantic representations learned from billions of images. However, when applied independently to 2D slices of a 3D scan, these models often produce noisy and anatomically implausible segmentations that violate the inherent continuity of anatomical structures. We propose a temporal adapter that addresses this by injecting adjacent-slice context directly into the model's visual token representations. The adapter comprises a temporal transformer attending across a fixed context window at the token level, a spatial context block refining within-slice representations, and an adaptive gate balancing temporal and single-slice features. Training on 30 labeled volumes from the FLARE22 dataset, our method achieves a mean Dice of 0.704 across 13 abdominal organs with a gain of +0.206 over the baseline VLM trained with no temporal context. Zero-shot evaluation on BTCV and AMOS22 datasets yields consistent improvements of +0.210 and +0.230, with the average cross-domain performance drop reducing from 38.0% to 24.9%. Furthermore, in a cross-modality evaluation on AMOS22 MRI with neither model receiving any MRI supervision, our method achieves a mean Dice of 0.366, outperforming a fully supervised 3D baseline (DynUNet, 0.224) trained exclusively on CT, suggesting that CLIP's visual semantic representations generalize more gracefully across imaging modalities than convolutional features.
comment: Accepted at the PHAROS-AIF-MIH Workshop at CVPR 2026

AI.title_translation: T-Gated Adapter：一种用于视觉语言医学分割的轻量级时间适配器
AI.tldr: 为解决视觉语言模型在 3D 医学影像分割中缺乏空间连续性的问题，本文提出了一种轻量级时间适配器，通过引入相邻切片信息显著提升了分割效果与跨模态泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的医学影像分割方法依赖大量专家标注，而直接应用视觉语言模型处理 3D 扫描时，由于缺乏对切片间解剖结构连续性的理解，导致分割结果存在噪声且不符合解剖逻辑。
AI.method: 提出一种包含时间 Transformer（用于处理跨切片上下文）、空间上下文块（用于精细化切片内特征）以及自适应门控机制（用于平衡时间与空间特征）的轻量级适配器。
AI.result: 在 FLARE22 数据集上 Mean Dice 达到 0.704（较基线提升 0.206）；在 BTCV 和 AMOS22 上实现显著的零样本提升；在跨模态（CT 到 MRI）任务中，该方法表现超越了全监督的 3D 基线模型。
AI.conclusion: T-Gated Adapter 通过引入时间上下文，显著提升了视觉语言模型在 3D 医学影像分割任务中的一致性和准确性，并展现出优异的跨数据集和跨模态泛化能力。
AI.translation: 医学图像分割传统上依赖于完全监督的 3D 架构，这些架构需要临床专家提供大量密集的体素级标注，这是一个极其昂贵的过程。视觉语言模型 (VLM) 通过利用从数十亿图像中学习到的广泛视觉语义表示，提供了一种强大的替代方案。然而，当独立应用于 3D 扫描的 2D 切片时，这些模型往往会产生噪声大且解剖学上不可信的分割结果，违反了解剖结构的固有连续性。我们提出了一个时间适配器，通过将相邻切片上下文直接注入模型的视觉标记表示来解决这个问题。该适配器包含一个在标记级别上跨固定上下文窗口进行注意的时间 Transformer、一个在切片内精细化表示的空间上下文块，以及一个平衡时间特征和单切片特征的自适应门控机制。在 FLARE22 数据集的 30 个标记卷上进行训练，我们的方法在 13 个腹部器官上实现了 0.704 的平均 Dice 系数，比没有时间上下文的基线 VLM 提高了 0.206。在 BTCV 和 AMOS22 数据集上的零样本评估显示出 +0.210 和 +0.230 的持续改进，平均跨域性能下降从 38.0% 降低到 24.9%。此外，在 AMOS22 MRI 的跨模态评估中（模型均未接受任何 MRI 监督），我们的方法达到了 0.366 的平均 Dice 系数，优于仅在 CT 上训练的完全监督 3D 基线（DynUNet，0.224），这表明 CLIP 的视觉语义表示比卷积特征在成像模态之间具有更好的泛化能力。
AI.summary: 针对医学图像分割中 3D 结构连续性难以保持的问题，本研究提出了一种 T-Gated 适配器。该适配器通过整合相邻切片的时间上下文信息，修正了视觉语言模型在独立处理 2D 切片时的不连贯性，显著提高了分割精度与跨模态泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 医学图像分割, 视觉语言模型, 时间适配器, 跨模态泛化, 3D一致性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将时间一致性引入视觉语言模型中，通过轻量级适配器解决了医疗影像分割中跨切片信息缺失的问题。其在少样本和跨模态场景下的优异表现，证明了利用大模型预训练知识进行医学图像分析的巨大潜力。限制在于仍依赖于特定切片上下文窗口，且在极端复杂解剖结构下的表现有待进一步验证。

title: ViVa: A Video-Generative Value Model for Robot Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced robot manipulation through large-scale pretraining, but real-world deployment remains challenging due to partial observability and delayed feedback. Reinforcement learning addresses this via value functions, which assess task progress and guide policy improvement. However, existing value models built on vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to capture temporal dynamics, undermining reliable value estimation in long-horizon tasks. In this paper, we propose ViVa, a video-generative value model that repurposes a pretrained video generator for value estimation. Taking the current observation and robot proprioception as input, ViVa jointly predicts future proprioception and a scalar value for the current state. By leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of a pretrained video generator, our approach grounds value estimation in anticipated embodiment dynamics, moving beyond static snapshots to intrinsically couple value with foresight. Integrated into RECAP, ViVa delivers substantial improvements on real-world box assembly. Qualitative analysis across all three tasks confirms that ViVa produces more reliable value signals, accurately reflecting task progress. By leveraging spatiotemporal priors from video corpora, ViVa also generalizes to novel objects, highlighting the promise of video-generative models for value estimation.

AI.title_translation: ViVa：用于机器人强化学习的视频生成价值模型
AI.tldr: ViVa 将视频生成模型引入机器人强化学习的价值估计中，通过预测未来动态来提高长时任务的价值评估准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于视觉语言模型的价值模型在处理长时任务时难以捕捉时序动态，导致价值估计不可靠，限制了机器人在现实世界中的部署。
AI.method: 提出 ViVa 模型，通过重用预训练的视频生成器，在输入当前观测和本体感知后，联合预测未来的本体感知和当前状态的标量价值，从而将价值估计与预期动态耦合。
AI.result: 在现实世界的箱子组装任务中取得了显著性能提升，能够提供更可靠的价值信号，并展现出对未知物体的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ViVa 通过将价值估计与视频生成过程耦合，有效地提升了机器人执行长时任务的能力，证明了视频生成模型在机器人强化学习中的巨大应用潜力。
AI.translation: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型通过大规模预训练推动了机器人操作的发展，但由于部分可观测性和反馈延迟，现实世界的部署仍然具有挑战性。强化学习通过价值函数来解决这一问题，价值函数可以评估任务进度并指导策略改进。然而，现有的基于视觉语言模型（VLM）构建的价值模型难以捕捉时序动态，破坏了长时任务中可靠的价值估计。在本文中，我们提出了 ViVa，这是一种视频生成价值模型，它重用了预训练的视频生成器来进行价值估计。ViVa 以当前观测和机器人本体感知作为输入，联合预测未来的本体感知和当前状态的标量价值。通过利用预训练视频生成器的时空先验，我们的方法将价值估计建立在预期的具身动态基础上，超越了静态快照，将价值与前瞻性内在耦合。集成到 RECAP 中，ViVa 在现实世界的箱子组装任务中取得了显著改进。对所有三项任务的定性分析证实，ViVa 产生了更可靠的价值信号，准确地反映了任务进度。通过利用视频语料库的时空先验，ViVa 还泛化到了新颖物体上，突显了视频生成模型在价值估计方面的潜力。
AI.summary: ViVa 是一种视频生成价值模型，它通过利用预训练视频生成器的时空先验，将价值估计与未来动态预测相结合，从而解决了机器人强化学习中长时任务价值评估不准确的问题。
AI.keywords: 机器人强化学习, 视频生成模型, 价值估计, 视觉语言模型, 时空先验
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将视频生成模型用于强化学习中的价值估计，利用视频生成模型强大的时空先验能力来克服传统价值模型在长时任务中对时序动态捕捉不足的问题，为机器人强化学习提供了一种新的思路。

title: Activation Steering for Aligned Open-ended Generation without Sacrificing Coherence
summary: Alignment in LLMs is more brittle than commonly assumed: misalignment can be triggered by adversarial prompts, benign fine-tuning, emergent misalignment, and goal misgeneralization. Recent evidence suggests that some misalignment behaviors are encoded as linear structure in activation space, making it tractable via steering, while safety alignment has been shown to govern the first few output tokens primarily, leaving subsequent generation unguarded. These findings motivate activation steering as a lightweight runtime defense that continuously corrects misaligned activations throughout generation. We evaluate three methods: Steer-With-Fixed-Coeff (SwFC), which applies uniform additive steering, and two novel projection-aware methods, Steer-to-Target-Projection (StTP) and Steer-to-Mirror-Projection (StMP), that use a logistic regression decision boundary to selectively intervene only on tokens whose activations fall below distributional thresholds. Using malicious system prompts as a controlled proxy for misalignment, we evaluate under two threat models (dishonesty and dismissiveness) and two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, Qwen3-32B). All methods substantially recover target traits (honesty and compassion) while preserving coherence. StTP and StMP better maintain general capabilities (MMLU, MT-Bench, AlpacaEval) and produce less repetition in multi-turn conversations.

AI.title_translation: 在不牺牲连贯性的前提下实现对齐开放式生成的激活引导
AI.tldr: 通过在生成过程中实时干预激活空间，该研究提出了一种能有效修正大语言模型不对齐行为，且不影响模型生成质量的轻量级防御方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的对齐机制脆弱，且现有的安全对齐主要关注初始生成阶段，无法覆盖长文本生成的后续过程。研究旨在通过激活空间的操作，实现一种轻量级、持续性的运行时对齐防御。
AI.method: 提出了三种激活引导方法：1. SwFC（固定系数引导）；2. StTP（目标投影引导）；3. StMP（镜像投影引导）。后两种方法利用逻辑回归决策边界，仅对特定阈值以下的激活进行干预。
AI.result: 实验表明，所有方法均能显著恢复模型的目标特性（诚实和同理心），同时保持生成连贯性。其中 StTP 和 StMP 在多轮对话中表现更优，能更好地维持通用能力，并减少重复输出。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导（Activation Steering）是一种有效的运行时防御手段，能够在不牺牲模型连贯性和基本能力的前提下，纠正大语言模型在开放式生成中的不对齐行为。
AI.translation: 大语言模型中的对齐比通常认为的更为脆弱：对抗性提示、良性微调、涌现出的不对齐以及目标泛化错误都可能触发不对齐行为。近期证据表明，一些不对齐行为在激活空间中表现为线性结构，这使得通过引导（steering）进行干预变得可行。同时，研究发现安全对齐主要控制生成的初始几个 token，导致后续生成缺乏保护。这些发现促使我们将激活引导作为一种轻量级的运行时防御手段，在整个生成过程中持续修正不对齐的激活。我们评估了三种方法：SwFC（固定系数引导），以及两种创新的投影感知方法 StTP（目标投影引导）和 StMP（镜像投影引导），它们利用逻辑回归决策边界，仅对激活值低于分布阈值的 token 进行干预。以恶意系统提示作为不对齐的受控代理，我们在两种威胁模型（不诚实和冷漠）和两种架构（Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, Qwen3-32B）下进行了评估。所有方法在保持连贯性的同时，均大幅恢复了目标特性（诚实和同理心）。StTP 和 StMP 能更好地维持通用能力（MMLU, MT-Bench, AlpacaEval），并在多轮对话中产生更少的重复内容。
AI.summary: 该论文针对大语言模型对齐脆弱及生成后期缺乏保护的问题，提出了一种基于激活引导的运行时防御框架。通过三种不同的引导策略（尤其是两种投影感知方法），模型能够在生成过程中持续纠正不对齐行为，从而在提升安全性的同时保留了模型原有的性能与连贯性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 对齐, 激活引导, 安全防御, 模型鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种轻量级、运行时防御机制，通过针对性地干预激活空间来修正模型的不对齐行为。创新点在于引入了投影感知（projection-aware）的方法，在纠正偏见的同时，通过逻辑回归边界避免了对正常生成过程的过度干扰，从而在保障安全性的同时维持了模型原有的生成质量和连贯性，具有很高的实用价值。

title: OceanMAE: A Foundation Model for Ocean Remote Sensing
summary: Accurate ocean mapping is essential for applications such as bathymetry estimation, seabed characterization, marine litter detection, and ecosystem monitoring. However, ocean remote sensing (RS) remains constrained by limited labeled data and by the reduced transferability of models pre-trained mainly on land-dominated Earth observation imagery. In this paper, we propose OceanMAE, an ocean-specific masked autoencoder that extends standard MAE pre-training by integrating multispectral Sentinel-2 observations with physically meaningful ocean descriptors during self-supervised learning. By incorporating these auxiliary ocean features, OceanMAE is designed to learn more informative and ocean-aware latent representations from large- scale unlabeled data. To transfer these representations to downstream applications, we further employ a modified UNet-based framework for marine segmentation and bathymetry estimation. Pre-trained on the Hydro dataset, OceanMAE is evaluated on MADOS and MARIDA for marine pollutant and debris segmentation, and on MagicBathyNet for bathymetry regression. The experiments show that OceanMAE yields the strongest gains on marine segmentation, while bathymetry benefits are competitive and task-dependent. In addition, an ablation against a standard MAE on MARIDA indicates that incorporating auxiliary ocean descriptors during pre-training improves downstream segmentation quality. These findings highlight the value of physically informed and domain-aligned self-supervised pre- training for ocean RS. Code and weights are publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/joanna.stamer/SSLORS2.

AI.title_translation: OceanMAE：一个用于海洋遥感的基座模型
AI.tldr: OceanMAE 通过在预训练中融合物理海洋特征，提升了模型在海洋遥感分割和水深估计任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 海洋遥感领域面临标注数据稀缺，且现有主要基于陆地图像预训练的模型在海洋场景下迁移效果不佳的问题。
AI.method: 提出 OceanMAE 模型，在标准 MAE 基础上，将多光谱 Sentinel-2 数据与具有物理意义的海洋描述符结合进行自监督预训练；下游任务采用改进的 UNet 架构进行海洋分割和水深测量。
AI.result: 在海洋污染物和碎片分割任务上取得了最优性能，在水深回归任务上表现具有竞争力。消融实验证明，引入辅助海洋描述符能有效提升下游分割质量。
AI.conclusion: OceanMAE 通过整合物理海洋描述符的自监督学习，显著提升了海洋遥感下游任务的性能，验证了领域对齐预训练在海洋遥感中的价值。
AI.translation: 精确的海洋测绘对于水深估计、海床表征、海洋垃圾检测和生态系统监测等应用至关重要。然而，海洋遥感（RS）仍受到标注数据有限以及主要在陆地主导的地球观测图像上预训练的模型迁移能力下降的限制。在本文中，我们提出了 OceanMAE，一种海洋专用掩码自编码器，它通过在自监督学习过程中整合多光谱 Sentinel-2 观测数据与具有物理意义的海洋描述符，扩展了标准 MAE 预训练。通过结合这些辅助海洋特征，OceanMAE 旨在从大规模未标注数据中学习更具信息量和海洋意识的潜在表示。为了将这些表示迁移到下游应用，我们进一步采用了一种改进的基于 UNet 的框架进行海洋分割和水深估计。OceanMAE 在 Hydro 数据集上进行预训练，并在 MADOS 和 MARIDA 上评估海洋污染物和碎片分割，在 MagicBathyNet 上评估水深回归。实验表明，OceanMAE 在海洋分割方面获得了最强的增益，而水深测量方面的收益具有竞争性且依赖于具体任务。此外，针对 MARIDA 上标准 MAE 的消融研究表明，在预训练期间加入辅助海洋描述符可以提高下游分割质量。这些发现强调了物理信息和领域对齐的自监督预训练对于海洋遥感的价值。代码和权重可在 https://git.tu-berlin.de/joanna.stamer/SSLORS2 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出 OceanMAE，一种专为海洋遥感设计的掩码自编码器。通过在自监督预训练中融合多光谱数据与物理海洋描述符，模型学习到了更具信息量的海洋特征。实验表明，该方法在海洋分割和水深测量任务中表现出色，验证了领域特异性预训练的优势。
AI.keywords: 海洋遥感, 掩码自编码器 (MAE), 自监督学习, 多光谱成像, 海洋制图
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将物理海洋描述符引入自监督预训练过程，解决了通用遥感模型在海洋领域迁移能力差的问题。它为特定领域（海洋）的基础模型构建提供了一个优秀的范式，证明了领域知识与自监督学习结合的有效性。

title: On the Global Photometric Alignment for Low-Level Vision
summary: Supervised low-level vision models rely on pixel-wise losses against paired references, yet paired training sets exhibit per-pair photometric inconsistency, say, different image pairs demand different global brightness, color, or white-balance mappings. This inconsistency enters through task-intrinsic photometric transfer (e.g., low-light enhancement) or unintended acquisition shifts (e.g., de-raining), and in either case causes an optimization pathology. Standard reconstruction losses allocate disproportionate gradient budget to conflicting per-pair photometric targets, crowding out content restoration. In this paper, we investigate this issue and prove that, under least-squares decomposition, the photometric and structural components of the prediction-target residual are orthogonal, and that the spatially dense photometric component dominates the gradient energy. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Photometric Alignment Loss (PAL). This flexible supervision objective discounts nuisance photometric discrepancy via closed-form affine color alignment while preserving restoration-relevant supervision, requiring only covariance statistics and tiny matrix inversion with negligible overhead. Across 6 tasks, 16 datasets, and 16 architectures, PAL consistently improves metrics and generalization. The implementation is in the appendix.

AI.title_translation: 关于低层视觉的全局光度对齐研究
AI.tldr: 针对低层视觉训练中因光度不一致导致的优化问题，提出PAL损失函数，通过自动对齐光度差异来提升模型恢复效果。
AI.motivation: 监督式低层视觉模型在训练时，成对数据集中存在固有的光度不一致性（如亮度、颜色差异），这会导致标准重构损失函数在优化过程中产生冲突，将过多的梯度预算分配给光度调整而非内容恢复，从而引发优化病理。
AI.method: 提出光度对齐损失（PAL），利用最小二乘分解将预测-目标残差分解为正交的光度分量和结构分量，并通过闭式仿射颜色对齐在损失计算中剔除光度偏差，仅保留结构相关的梯度。
AI.result: 在6项任务、16个数据集和16种架构上进行了验证，结果表明PAL能够始终如一地提升模型性能和泛化能力，且计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: PAL通过在损失函数中显式解耦光度差异与结构信息，有效解决了低层视觉训练中的优化病理问题，实现了性能和泛化能力的稳健提升。
AI.translation: 监督式低层视觉模型依赖于像素级的参考损失，然而成对训练集存在每对之间的光度不一致性，即不同的图像对需要不同的全局亮度、颜色或白平衡映射。这种不一致性源于任务固有的光度转换（如低光增强）或意外的采集偏移（如去雨），无论哪种情况都会导致优化病理。标准的重构损失将不成比例的梯度预算分配给相互冲突的每对光度目标，从而挤占了内容恢复的空间。在本文中，我们研究了这个问题，并证明在最小二乘分解下，预测-目标残差的光度和结构分量是正交的，且空间密集的光度分量主导了梯度能量。受此分析启发，我们提出了光度对齐损失（PAL）。这一灵活的监督目标通过闭式仿射颜色对齐消除了干扰性的光度差异，同时保留了与恢复相关的监督信息，仅需协方差统计和极小的矩阵求逆，开销可忽略不计。在6项任务、16个数据集和16种架构上，PAL均能持续改善指标和泛化能力。实现代码见附录。
AI.summary: 本文针对低层视觉任务中训练数据存在的光度不一致性问题，分析了其导致的优化困难，并提出了一种名为PAL的损失函数，通过闭式代数方法消除不必要的光度偏移，从而专注于图像结构恢复，提升了模型效果。
AI.keywords: 低层视觉, 光度对齐损失, 优化病理, 图像恢复, 监督学习
AI.comments: 该研究通过数学分析揭示了低层视觉任务中光度不一致性对模型优化的负面影响，并提出了一种轻量级、通用的损失函数改进方案，具有很高的实用价值和理论深度。

title: Exploration of Pareto-preserving Search Space Transformations in Multi-objective Test Functions
summary:
Benchmark problems are an important tool for gaining understanding of optimization algorithms. Since algorithms often aim to perform well on benchmarks, biases in benchmark design provide misleading insights. In single-objective optimization, for example, many problems used to have their optimum in the center of the search domain. To remedy these issues, search space transformations have been widely adopted by benchmark suites, preventing algorithms from exploiting unintended structure.
  In multi-objective optimization, problem design has focused primarily on the objective space structure. While this focus addresses important aspects of the multi-objective nature of the problems, the search space structures of these problems have received comparatively limited attention. In this work, we re-emphasize the importance of transformations in the search space, and address the challenges inherent in adding transformations to boundary constraints problems without impacting the structure of the objective space. We utilized two parameterized, bijective transformations to create different instantiations of popular benchmark problems, and show how these changes impact the performance of various multi-objective optimization algorithms. In addition to the search space transformations, we show that such parameterized transformations can also be applied to the objective space, and compare their respective performance impacts.

AI.title_translation: 多目标测试函数中帕累托保持搜索空间变换的探索
AI.tldr: 本文提出通过参数化变换改变多目标优化问题的搜索空间结构，以防止算法利用基准测试中的非预期偏差，从而提供更准确的性能评估。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注多目标优化中的目标空间结构，而忽视了搜索空间结构，导致算法可能利用基准测试中的非预期结构，从而产生误导性的性能评价。
AI.method: 利用两种参数化的双射变换（bijective transformations）对流行基准问题进行实例化，并对比了搜索空间变换与目标空间变换对多目标优化算法性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验证明，通过搜索空间变换生成的不同实例能够显著影响多目标优化算法的性能，且该方法能有效规避算法对特定问题的潜在偏差。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，搜索空间变换能有效防止算法利用基准测试中的非预期结构，且与目标空间变换相比具有不同的性能影响，对于构建更具挑战性和公平性的基准测试至关重要。
AI.translation: 基准问题是深入理解优化算法的重要工具。由于算法通常旨在在基准测试中表现良好，基准设计中的偏差往往会提供误导性的见解。例如，在单目标优化中，许多问题过去将其最优解置于搜索域的中心。为了解决这些问题，基准测试套件广泛采用了搜索空间变换，以防止算法利用非预期的结构。在多目标优化中，问题设计主要集中在目标空间结构上。虽然这种关注解决了多目标问题的重要方面，但这些问题的搜索空间结构却相对较少受到关注。在这项工作中，我们重新强调了搜索空间变换的重要性，并解决了在不影响目标空间结构的情况下，向边界约束问题添加变换所固有的挑战。我们利用两种参数化的双射变换来创建流行基准问题的不同实例，并展示了这些变化如何影响各种多目标优化算法的性能。除了搜索空间变换外，我们还展示了这种参数化变换也可以应用于目标空间，并比较了它们各自的性能影响。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了多目标优化基准测试中搜索空间结构的重要性。针对现有基准测试忽视搜索空间变换的问题，作者提出使用参数化双射变换在不改变目标空间结构的前提下修改搜索空间，并验证了这些变换对多目标优化算法性能评价的显著影响。
AI.keywords: 多目标优化, 基准测试, 搜索空间变换, 帕累托最优, 算法性能
AI.comments: 本文通过引入搜索空间变换，揭示了多目标优化基准测试中对搜索空间结构关注不足的问题。其创新之处在于提出了一种在不改变目标空间结构的前提下，对受限约束问题进行搜索空间变换的方法，这对评估算法的鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: Value-Guidance MeanFlow for Offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) aims to learn the optimal joint policy from pre-collected datasets, requiring a trade-off between maximizing global returns and mitigating distribution shift from offline data. Recent studies use diffusion or flow generative models to capture complex joint policy behaviors among agents; however, they typically rely on multi-step iterative sampling, thereby reducing training and inference efficiency. Although further research improves sampling efficiency through methods like distillation, it remains sensitive to the behavior regularization coefficient. To address the above-mentioned issues, we propose Value Guidance Multi-agent MeanFlow Policy (VGM$^2$P), a simple yet effective flow-based policy learning framework that enables efficient action generation with coefficient-insensitive conditional behavior cloning. Specifically, VGM$^2$P uses global advantage values to guide agent collaboration, treating optimal policy learning as conditional behavior cloning. Additionally, to improve policy expressiveness and inference efficiency in multi-agent scenarios, it leverages classifier-free guidance MeanFlow for both policy training and execution. Experiments on tasks with both discrete and continuous action spaces demonstrate that, even when trained solely via conditional behavior cloning, VGM$^2$P efficiently achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.title_translation: 面向离线多智能体强化学习的价值引导MeanFlow策略
AI.tldr: VGM$^2$P是一种新型离线多智能体强化学习框架，通过价值引导的条件行为克隆和无分类器MeanFlow，在保证高性能的同时显著提升了采样和推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散或流模型的离线MARL方法虽然能捕捉复杂的联合策略，但存在多步迭代采样导致效率低，以及对行为正则化系数敏感的问题。
AI.method: 提出了VGM$^2$P框架，利用全局优势值引导智能体协作，将策略学习转化为条件行为克隆问题；并引入无分类器引导的MeanFlow机制，以提升策略表达能力和推理效率。
AI.result: 在离散和连续动作空间任务上的实验表明，VGM$^2$P仅通过条件行为克隆即可实现与当前最先进方法相当的性能，同时具备更高的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: VGM$^2$P提出了一种高效的流模型框架，通过价值引导和无分类器MeanFlow，实现了在离线多智能体任务中无需复杂正则化的高性能策略学习。
AI.translation: 离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）旨在从预先收集的数据集中学习最优联合策略，这需要在最大化全局回报与减轻离线数据分布偏移之间进行权衡。近期的研究利用扩散或流生成模型来捕捉智能体之间复杂的联合策略行为；然而，它们通常依赖于多步迭代采样，从而降低了训练和推理效率。尽管后续研究通过蒸馏等方法提高了采样效率，但仍对行为正则化系数敏感。为了解决上述问题，我们提出了价值引导多智能体MeanFlow策略（VGM$^2$P），这是一个简单而有效的基于流的策略学习框架，实现了具有系数不敏感条件行为克隆的高效动作生成。具体而言，VGM$^2$P利用全局优势值来引导智能体协作，将最优策略学习视为条件行为克隆。此外，为了提高多智能体场景下的策略表达能力和推理效率，它在策略训练和执行中均利用了无分类器引导的MeanFlow。在离散和连续动作空间任务上的实验表明，即使仅通过条件行为克隆进行训练，VGM$^2$P也能高效地实现与最先进方法相当的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为VGM$^2$P的离线多智能体强化学习框架，旨在解决现有流模型方法在采样效率和正则化敏感性方面的缺陷。该方法通过全局优势值引导实现智能体协作，并将最优策略学习建模为条件行为克隆，结合无分类器引导的MeanFlow，实现了高效且高性能的策略生成。
AI.keywords: 离线多智能体强化学习, MeanFlow, 价值引导, 条件行为克隆, 采样效率
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入MeanFlow和无分类器引导（Classifier-free Guidance）机制，成功解决了离线多智能体强化学习中采样效率与策略表达能力之间的矛盾。其创新点在于将复杂的策略优化简化为条件行为克隆，并证明了在适当的价值引导下，无需复杂的正则化也能达到SOTA水平，具有很高的实用价值。

title: The restrictive conditions to solve LTI Systems by Ordinary Differential Equations
summary: Ordinary differential equations (ODE's) are a cornerstone of systems and control theory. Accordingly, they are standard material in undergraduate programs in engineering and there is abundant didactic literature about this topic. Yet, the solution methods and formulas prescribed in this didactic literature are unclear about the assumptions behind their derivation and thus about the limits of their applicability. Specifically, smoothness of the input is rarely discussed, even though it is a critical property to define the character of the solutions and the validity of the methods and formulas prescribed. On the other hand, the relationships with the state space representation (SSR) of linear systems is absent from this same literature and only marginally discussed in more advanced texts. In this paper we detail these gaps left behind in the didactic literature, then we provide a formal delimitation of the boundaries of the standard solutions and methods for linear ODE's. Our analysis relies on some key properties of state space representations, so we establish the formal connections between ODEs and SSR's, defining an equivalence between the two that is absent in the literature and is of conceptual interest by itself.

AI.title_translation: 求解线性时不变系统的常微分方程的限制性条件
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了线性时不变系统教学中常微分方程求解方法的边界限制，并通过建立与状态空间表示的联系，填补了现有文献的理论空白。
AI.motivation: 现有教学文献在处理线性时不变系统时，往往忽视了输入信号平滑度等关键数学假设，且缺乏与状态空间表示的联系，导致求解方法的适用边界模糊。
AI.method: 分析现有教学文献的局限性，利用状态空间表示的关键属性，建立常微分方程与状态空间表示之间的形式化连接与等价关系。
AI.result: 明确了线性常微分方程标准解法和公式的适用边界，并定义了常微分方程与状态空间表示之间的等价性。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过建立常微分方程与状态空间表示之间的正式等价关系，明确了传统线性系统求解方法的数学边界和适用条件。
AI.translation: 常微分方程（ODE）是系统与控制理论的基石。因此，它们是工程本科课程的标准内容，且有大量关于该主题的教学文献。然而，这些教学文献中规定的求解方法和公式对于其推导背后的假设以及适用范围并不明确。具体而言，很少讨论输入的平滑性，尽管这是定义解的性质以及所规定方法和公式有效性的关键属性。另一方面，这些文献中缺失了与线性系统状态空间表示（SSR）的关系，仅在更高级的文本中略有讨论。在本文中，我们详细说明了教学文献中留下的这些空白，然后提供了线性常微分方程标准解法和方法的正式边界界定。我们的分析依赖于状态空间表示的一些关键属性，因此我们建立了常微分方程与SSR之间的正式联系，定义了两者之间在文献中缺失且本身具有概念意义的等价关系。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了线性时不变系统求解中常微分方程的教学局限，指出传统教材缺乏对输入平滑度等假设的讨论。通过建立常微分方程与状态空间表示的正式联系，本文界定了标准求解方法的适用范围。
AI.keywords: 常微分方程, 线性时不变系统, 状态空间表示, 数学假设, 系统理论教学
AI.comments: 该论文指出了工程教育中常被忽视的基础理论严谨性问题，通过连接状态空间表示与常微分方程，填补了教学文献在数学假设和适用范围上的空白，具有很高的教学价值。

title: Aligning Agents via Planning: A Benchmark for Trajectory-Level Reward Modeling
comments: 13 pages, 5 figures, accepted to ACL 2026 main conference
summary: In classical Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), Reward Models (RMs) serve as the fundamental signal provider for model alignment. As Large Language Models evolve into agentic systems capable of autonomous tool invocation and complex reasoning, the paradigm of reward modeling faces unprecedented challenges--most notably, the lack of benchmarks specifically designed to assess RM capabilities within tool-integrated environments. To address this gap, we present Plan-RewardBench, a trajectory-level preference benchmark designed to evaluate how well judges distinguish preferred versus distractor agent trajectories in complex tool-using scenarios. Plan-RewardBench covers four representative task families -- (i) Safety Refusal, (ii) Tool-Irrelevance / Unavailability, (iii) Complex Planning, and (iv) Robust Error Recovery -- comprising validated positive trajectories and confusable hard negatives constructed via multi-model natural rollouts, rule-based perturbations, and minimal-edit LLM perturbations. We benchmark representative RMs (generative, discriminative, and LLM-as-Judge) under a unified pairwise protocol, reporting accuracy trends across varying trajectory lengths and task categories. Furthermore, we provide diagnostic analyses of prevalent failure modes. Our results reveal that all three evaluator families face substantial challenges, with performance degrading sharply on long-horizon trajectories, underscoring the necessity for specialized training in agentic, trajectory-level reward modeling. Ultimately, Plan-RewardBench aims to serve as both a practical evaluation suite and a reusable blueprint for constructing agentic planning preference data.
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, accepted to ACL 2026 main conference

AI.title_translation: 通过规划对齐智能体：轨迹级奖励建模基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Plan-RewardBench基准，用于评估智能体在复杂工具使用场景下的轨迹级奖励模型表现，研究发现现有模型在长轨迹任务上表现欠佳，亟需专门训练。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型向智能体系统演进，传统的奖励模型（RM）缺乏针对工具集成环境下的专门评估基准，难以有效衡量模型在复杂规划和长轨迹任务中的表现。
AI.method: 提出了Plan-RewardBench基准，涵盖安全拒绝、工具无关性、复杂规划和鲁棒错误恢复四个任务家族；通过多模型滚动、规则扰动和LLM最小编辑构建正负样本；在统一的成对比较协议下，对生成式、判别式及LLM-as-Judge三类奖励模型进行评估和诊断分析。
AI.result: 实验表明，所有被测的奖励模型在处理长轨迹任务时性能均大幅下降；现有的三类评估器在面对复杂Agent场景时均面临严峻挑战。
AI.conclusion: Plan-RewardBench 揭示了现有奖励模型在处理长轨迹智能体任务时的显著局限性，证明了专门针对轨迹级奖励建模进行训练的必要性，并为未来构建智能体偏好数据提供了标准范式。
AI.translation: 在传统的人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）中，奖励模型（RM）是模型对齐的基础信号提供者。随着大语言模型演变为能够自主调用工具和进行复杂推理的智能体系统，奖励建模范式面临着前所未有的挑战——最显著的是缺乏专门设计用于评估工具集成环境中RM能力的基准。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Plan-RewardBench，这是一个轨迹级偏好基准，旨在评估评判模型在复杂工具使用场景中区分首选智能体轨迹与干扰轨迹的能力。Plan-RewardBench涵盖了四个代表性的任务家族——(i) 安全拒绝、(ii) 工具无关/不可用、(iii) 复杂规划以及(iv) 鲁棒错误恢复，包含了通过多模型自然滚动、基于规则的扰动和最小编辑LLM扰动构建的验证正向轨迹和易混淆的困难负样本。我们在统一的成对协议下对代表性RM（生成式、判别式和LLM-as-Judge）进行了基准测试，报告了跨不同轨迹长度和任务类别的准确率趋势。此外，我们提供了对常见失效模式的诊断分析。结果显示，所有三类评估器都面临巨大挑战，性能在长程轨迹上急剧下降，强调了在智能体轨迹级奖励建模中进行专门训练的必要性。最终，Plan-RewardBench旨在作为实用的评估套件和构建智能体规划偏好数据的可复用蓝图。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Plan-RewardBench，这是一个专门用于评估智能体轨迹级偏好的基准测试。该基准涵盖了四个关键任务领域，通过构建包含正向轨迹和易混淆负样本的数据集，对现有的各类奖励模型进行了全面评估，揭示了当前模型在处理复杂长轨迹任务时的性能瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 智能体对齐, 奖励建模, 轨迹级偏好, 规划能力, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该论文针对当前智能体（Agent）领域缺乏有效的奖励模型（RM）评估基准这一核心痛点，提出了Plan-RewardBench。其创新之处在于引入了轨迹级别的偏好评估，并涵盖了安全、工具使用、复杂规划及错误恢复等关键场景，为提升智能体对齐能力提供了重要的衡量工具和研究方向。

title: Long-Term Embeddings for Balanced Personalization
summary: Modern transformer-based sequential recommenders excel at capturing short-term intent but often suffer from recency bias, overlooking stable long-term preferences. While extending sequence lengths is an intuitive fix, it is computationally inefficient, and recent interactions tend to dominate the model's attention. We propose Long-Term Embeddings (LTE) as a high-inertia contextual anchor to bridge this gap. We address a critical production challenge: the point-in-time consistency problem caused by infrastructure constraints, as feature stores typically host only a single "live" version of features. This leads to an offline-online mismatch during model deployments and rollbacks, as models are forced to process evolved representations they never saw during training. To resolve this, we introduce an LTE framework that constrains embeddings to a fixed semantic basis of content-based item representations, ensuring cross-version compatibility. Furthermore, we investigate integration strategies for causal language modeling, considering the data leakage issue that occurs when the LTE and the transformer's short-term sequence share a temporal horizon. We evaluate two representations: a heuristic average and an asymmetric autoencoder with a fixed decoder grounded in the semantic basis to enable behavioral fine-tuning while maintaining stability. Online A/B tests on Zalando demonstrate that integrating LTE as a contextual prefix token using a lagged window yields significant uplifts in both user engagement and financial metrics.

AI.title_translation: 用于平衡个性化的长期嵌入研究
AI.tldr: 通过引入基于固定语义基的长期嵌入，解决了推荐系统中近因偏差和生产环境下的特征不一致问题，有效提升了推荐效果。
AI.motivation: 现代Transformer序列推荐模型过度依赖短期交互，容易产生近因偏差，忽略用户稳定的长期偏好；同时，生产环境中的特征不一致性问题导致离线与在线模型效果存在偏差。
AI.method: 提出Long-Term Embeddings (LTE)框架，通过将嵌入约束在固定的内容语义基上实现跨版本兼容；采用非对称自编码器进行行为微调；在模型中将LTE作为上下文前缀令牌，并使用滞后窗口策略避免数据泄露。
AI.result: 在Zalando的在线A/B测试中，该方法显著提升了用户参与度和财务指标，证明了LTE作为上下文锚点的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将长期嵌入作为上下文锚点，结合固定语义基和滞后窗口策略，该框架有效平衡了短期的意图捕捉与长期的偏好稳定，显著提升了电商场景下的用户互动与商业指标。
AI.translation: 现代基于Transformer的序列推荐器擅长捕捉短期意图，但往往受到近因偏差的影响，忽视了稳定的长期偏好。虽然增加序列长度是一种直观的解决方法，但其计算效率低下，且近期的交互往往会主导模型的注意力。我们提出了长期嵌入（LTE）作为一种高惯性的上下文锚点来弥补这一差距。我们解决了生产环境中的一个关键挑战：即由于基础设施限制导致的点对点一致性问题，因为特征存储通常只托管一个“实时”版本的特征。这会导致模型部署和回滚期间出现离线-在线不匹配，因为模型被迫处理它们在训练期间从未见过的演化表示。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个LTE框架，将嵌入约束在基于内容的物品表示的固定语义基上，确保了跨版本兼容性。此外，我们研究了因果语言模型的集成策略，考虑了当LTE和Transformer的短期序列共享时间跨度时发生的数据泄露问题。我们评估了两种表示方法：启发式平均和具有固定解码器的非对称自编码器，该解码器基于语义基，能够在保持稳定性的同时进行行为微调。在Zalando进行的在线A/B测试表明，将LTE作为具有滞后窗口的上下文前缀令牌，在用户参与度和财务指标上均产生了显著的提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了长期嵌入（LTE）框架，旨在克服序列推荐模型中的近因偏差。通过引入基于内容的固定语义基，LTE解决了生产环境中的点对点一致性问题。该方法通过将LTE作为上下文前缀并结合滞后窗口，有效整合了用户长期偏好与短期意图，在保障模型稳定性的同时提升了推荐性能。
AI.keywords: 长期嵌入, 序列推荐, 近因偏差, 语义基, 生产一致性
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“长期嵌入（LTE）”来解决序列推荐中常见的近因偏差问题，创新点在于提出了“固定语义基”这一机制，成功解决了生产环境中常见的点对点一致性问题，具有极高的工业应用价值。其方法在处理计算效率与模型稳定性之间的平衡上表现出色。

title: Wattlytics: A Web Platform for Co-Optimizing Performance, Energy, and TCO in HPC Clusters
summary: The escalating computational demands and energy footprint of GPU-accelerated computing systems complicate informed design and operational decisions. We present the first release of Wattlytics (https://wattlytics.netlify.app), an interactive, browser-based decision-support system. Unlike existing procurement-oriented calculators, Wattlytics uniquely integrates benchmark-driven GPU performance scaling, dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS)-aware piecewise power modeling, and multi-year total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis within a single interactive environment. Users can configure heterogeneous systems across contemporary GPU architectures (GH200, H100, L40S, L40, A40, A100, and L4), select representative scientific workloads (e.g., GROMACS, AMBER), and explore deployment scenarios under constraints such as energy prices, system lifetime, and frequency scaling. Wattlytics computes multidimensional decision metrics (TCO breakdown, work-per-TCO, power-per-TCO, and work-per-watt-per-TCO) and supports design-space exploration, what-if scenarios, sensitivity metrics (elasticity, Sobol indices, Monte Carlo) and collaborative features to guide realistic cluster design and procurement under uncertainty. We demonstrate selected scenarios comparing deployment strategies under different operational modes: ixed budget, fixed GPU count, fixed performance, and fixed power. Our case studies show that, under budget or energy constraints, optimally deployed energy-efficient GPUs can outperform higher-performance alternatives in overall cost-effectiveness. Wattlytics helps users explore the design parameter space and distinguish between cost- and risk-driving factors, turning HPC design into a well-informed and explainable decision-making process.

AI.title_translation: Wattlytics：一个用于协同优化HPC集群性能、能效和TCO的Web平台
AI.tldr: Wattlytics是一个创新的Web平台，通过整合GPU性能、功耗建模与TCO分析，帮助用户在能源和预算约束下做出最优的HPC集群设计决策。
AI.motivation: 面对高性能计算（HPC）系统日益增长的计算需求和能耗压力，现有的采购计算器无法有效支持复杂的多维度设计决策，缺乏对性能、能耗和成本的综合权衡。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于Web的交互式平台，整合了基于基准测试的GPU性能缩放、感知DVFS（动态电压频率调整）的功耗建模、多年度TCO分析，以及包括Sobol指数和蒙特卡洛模拟在内的敏感性分析方法。
AI.result: 通过案例研究表明，在固定预算或固定能耗约束下，优化部署的能效型GPU在整体成本效益上往往优于高性能但高功耗的替代方案。该平台能有效帮助用户识别系统设计中的成本和风险驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: Wattlytics为HPC集群的采购与运维提供了一个可视化的决策支持平台，证明了在能源和预算约束下，能源效率较高的GPU往往能提供更佳的整体成本效益。
AI.translation: 随着GPU加速计算系统计算需求和能耗足迹的不断攀升，做出知情的系统设计和运维决策变得日益复杂。我们发布了Wattlytics（https://wattlytics.netlify.app），这是一个基于浏览器的交互式决策支持系统。与现有的侧重于采购的计算器不同，Wattlytics在单一交互环境中独特地集成了基于基准测试的GPU性能缩放、感知DVFS（动态电压频率调整）的分段功耗建模以及多年期总拥有成本（TCO）分析。用户可以配置涵盖当代GPU架构（GH200、H100、L40S、L40、A40、A100和L4）的异构系统，选择代表性的科学工作负载（如GROMACS、AMBER），并在能源价格、系统寿命和频率缩放等约束条件下探索部署场景。Wattlytics计算多维决策指标（TCO细分、单位TCO工作量、单位TCO功耗、单位TCO单位功耗工作量），并支持设计空间探索、“假设”分析、敏感性指标（弹性、Sobol指数、蒙特卡洛）以及协作功能，以指导在不确定性下的现实集群设计与采购。我们演示了在不同运维模式下（固定预算、固定GPU数量、固定性能和固定功耗）比较部署策略的选定场景。我们的案例研究表明，在预算或能源约束下，优化部署的能效型GPU在整体成本效益上可以超越高性能替代方案。Wattlytics帮助用户探索设计参数空间，并区分成本驱动因素和风险驱动因素，将HPC设计转化为一个信息充分且可解释的决策过程。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Wattlytics，这是一个基于Web的交互式决策支持平台，专门用于优化HPC集群的性能、能效和总拥有成本（TCO）。该平台集成了GPU性能建模、DVFS感知功耗分析和TCO计算，并支持敏感性分析和多种部署场景探索，旨在通过数据驱动的方式提升HPC系统采购和运维决策的科学性与透明度。
AI.keywords: HPC集群, GPU性能, 能源效率, 总拥有成本(TCO), 决策支持系统
AI.comments: Wattlytics填补了HPC领域在系统采购和运维阶段缺乏集成化决策工具的空白。其创新之处在于将基准测试性能、功耗建模与TCO分析深度结合，并引入了敏感性分析，使HPC集群的设计从“经验驱动”转向“数据驱动”。局限性在于其分析精度可能受限于所选基准测试的代表性。

title: AT-ADD: All-Type Audio Deepfake Detection Challenge Evaluation Plan
comments: Accepted to the ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge
summary: The rapid advancement of Audio Large Language Models (ALLMs) has enabled cost-effective, high-fidelity generation and manipulation of both speech and non-speech audio, including sound effects, singing voices, and music. While these capabilities foster creativity and content production, they also introduce significant security and trust challenges, as realistic audio deepfakes can now be generated and disseminated at scale. Existing audio deepfake detection (ADD) countermeasures (CMs) and benchmarks, however, remain largely speech-centric, often relying on speech-specific artifacts and exhibiting limited robustness to real-world distortions, as well as restricted generalization to heterogeneous audio types and emerging spoofing techniques. To address these gaps, we propose the All-Type Audio Deepfake Detection (AT-ADD) Grand Challenge for ACM Multimedia 2026, designed to bridge controlled academic evaluation with practical multimedia forensics. AT-ADD comprises two tracks: (1) Robust Speech Deepfake Detection, which evaluates detectors under real-world scenarios and against unseen, state-of-the-art speech generation methods; and (2) All-Type Audio Deepfake Detection, which extends detection beyond speech to diverse, unknown audio types and promotes type-agnostic generalization across speech, sound, singing, and music. By providing standardized datasets, rigorous evaluation protocols, and reproducible baselines, AT-ADD aims to accelerate the development of robust and generalizable audio forensic technologies, supporting secure communication, reliable media verification, and responsible governance in an era of pervasive synthetic audio.
comment: Accepted to the ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge

AI.title_translation: AT-ADD：全类型音频深度伪造检测挑战赛评估计划
AI.tldr: AT-ADD挑战赛旨在解决现有检测技术对非语音音频泛化性差的问题，推动构建鲁棒的音频取证技术。
AI.motivation: 音频大模型的发展使得高质量伪造音频泛滥，但现有的检测技术主要集中于语音，缺乏对非语音音频的检测能力及对真实复杂环境的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出AT-ADD大挑战赛，包含两个赛道：一是鲁棒语音伪造检测（针对真实场景和未知生成方法），二是全类型音频伪造检测（涵盖语音、音效、歌声和音乐，强调类型无关的泛化能力）。
AI.result: 通过提供标准化数据集、评估协议和可复现的基线系统，为学术界和工业界提供评估平台，推动音频取证技术的进步。
AI.conclusion: AT-ADD挑战赛通过标准化评估和多类型音频检测任务，旨在提升音频取证技术的鲁棒性与泛化能力，以应对生成式AI带来的安全风险。
AI.translation: 音频大模型（ALLMs）的快速发展实现了语音和非语音音频（包括音效、歌声和音乐）的高保真生成与编辑。尽管这些能力促进了创作和内容生产，但也带来了巨大的安全和信任挑战，因为逼真的音频深度伪造现在可以大规模生成和传播。然而，现有的音频深度伪造检测（ADD）对策（CMs）和基准测试在很大程度上仍然以语音为中心，通常依赖于特定于语音的伪影，并且在真实世界的失真下表现出有限的鲁棒性，以及在异构音频类型和新兴欺骗技术上的泛化能力受到限制。为了弥补这些差距，我们提出了ACM Multimedia 2026的“全类型音频深度伪造检测（AT-ADD）大挑战赛”，旨在将受控的学术评估与实际的多媒体取证联系起来。AT-ADD包含两个赛道：（1）鲁棒语音深度伪造检测，评估检测器在真实场景下以及针对未见过的、最先进的语音生成方法的表现；（2）全类型音频深度伪造检测，将检测范围从语音扩展到多样化的、未知的音频类型，并促进跨语音、声音、歌声和音乐的类型无关泛化。通过提供标准化的数据集、严格的评估协议和可复现的基线，AT-ADD旨在加速稳健且可泛化的音频取证技术的开发，支持安全通信、可靠的媒体验证以及在普遍合成音频时代的负责任治理。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了针对ACM Multimedia 2026的AT-ADD挑战赛，旨在解决当前音频深度伪造检测过于关注语音、泛化能力不足的问题。挑战赛涵盖语音鲁棒性检测和全类型（含音乐、音效等）音频伪造检测，致力于提升多媒体取证技术的鲁棒性与通用性。

title: State and Trajectory Estimation of Tensegrity Robots via Factor Graphs and Chebyshev Polynomials
summary: Tensegrity robots offer compliance and adaptability, but their nonlinear, and underconstrained dynamics make state estimation challenging. Reliable continuous-time estimation of all rigid links is crucial for closed-loop control, system identification, and machine learning; however, conventional methods often fall short. This paper proposes a two-stage approach for robust state or trajectory estimation (i.e., filtering or smoothing) of a cable-driven tensegrity robot. For online state estimation, this work introduces a factor-graph-based method, which fuses measurements from an RGB-D camera with on-board cable length sensors. To the best of the authors' knowledge, this is the first application of factor graphs in this domain. Factor graphs are a natural choice, as they exploit the robot's structural properties and provide effective sensor fusion solutions capable of handling nonlinearities in practice. Both the Mahalanobis distance-based clustering algorithm, used to handle noise, and the Chebyshev polynomial method, used to estimate the most probable velocities and intermediate states, are shown to perform well on simulated and real-world data, compared to an ICP-based algorithm. Results show that the approach provides high fidelity, continuous-time state and trajectory estimates for complex tensegrity robot motions.

title: Equivariant Efficient Joint Discrete and Continuous MeanFlow for Molecular Graph Generation
summary: Graph-structured data jointly contain discrete topology and continuous geometry, which poses fundamental challenges for generative modeling due to heterogeneous distributions, incompatible noise dynamics, and the need for equivariant inductive biases. Existing flow-matching approaches for graph generation typically decouple structure from geometry, lack synchronized cross-domain dynamics, and rely on iterative sampling, often resulting in physically inconsistent molecular conformations and slow sampling. To address these limitations, we propose Equivariant MeanFlow (EQUIMF), a unified SE(3)-equivariant generative framework that jointly models discrete and continuous components through synchronized MeanFlow dynamics. EQUIMF introduces a unified time bridge and average-velocity updates with mutual conditioning between structure and geometry, enabling efficient few-step generation while preserving physical consistency. Moreover, we develop a novel discrete MeanFlow formulation with a simple yet effective parameterization to support efficient generation over discrete graph structures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EQUIMF consistently outperforms prior diffusion and flow-matching methods in generation quality, physical validity, and sampling efficiency.

title: Inside-Out: Measuring Generalization in Vision Transformers Through Inner Workings
summary: Reliable generalization metrics are fundamental to the evaluation of machine learning models. Especially in high-stakes applications where labeled target data are scarce, evaluation of models' generalization performance under distribution shift is a pressing need. We focus on two practical scenarios: (1) Before deployment, how to select the best model for unlabeled target data? (2) After deployment, how to monitor model performance under distribution shift? The central need in both cases is a reliable and label-free proxy metric. Yet existing proxy metrics, such as model confidence or accuracy-on-the-line, are often unreliable as they only assess model output while ignoring the internal mechanisms that produce them. We address this limitation by introducing a new perspective: using the inner workings of a model, i.e., circuits, as a predictive metric of generalization performance. Leveraging circuit discovery, we extract the causal interactions between internal representations as a circuit, from which we derive two metrics tailored to the two practical scenarios. (1) Before deployment, we introduce Dependency Depth Bias, which measures different models' generalization capability on target data. (2) After deployment, we propose Circuit Shift Score, which predicts a model's generalization under different distribution shifts. Across various tasks, both metrics demonstrate significantly improved correlation with generalization performance, outperforming existing proxies by an average of 13.4\% and 34.1\%, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/deep-real/GenCircuit.

title: Approximation of the Basset force in the Maxey-Riley-Gatignol equations via universal differential equations
summary: The Maxey-Riley-Gatignol equations (MaRGE) model the motion of spherical inertial particles in a fluid. They contain the Basset force, an integral term which models history effects due to the formation of wakes and boundary layer effects. This causes the force that acts on a particle to depend on its past trajectory and complicates the numerical solution of MaRGE. Therefore, the Basset force is often neglected, despite substantial evidence that it has both quantitative and qualitative impact on the movement patterns of modelled particles. Using the concept of universal differential equations, we propose an approximation of the history term via neural networks which approximates MaRGE by a system of ordinary differential equations that can be solved with standard numerical solvers like Runge-Kutta methods.

title: Beyond Static Forecasting: Unleashing the Power of World Models for Mobile Traffic Extrapolation
summary: Mobile traffic prediction is a fundamental yet challenging problem for wireless network planning and optimization. Existing models focus on learning static long-term temporal patterns in mobile traffic series, which limits their ability to capture the dynamics between mobile traffic and network parameter adjustments. In this paper, we propose MobiWM, a world model for mobile networks. Taking mobile traffic as the system state, MobiWM models the dynamics between the states and network parameter actions, including power, azimuth, mechanical tilt, and electrical tilt through a predictive backbone. It fuses multimodal environmental contexts, comprising both image and sequential data, with encoded actions, leveraging shared spatial semantics to enhance spatial understanding. Leveraging the capacity of world models to capture real-world operational dynamics, MobiWM supports unlimited-horizon rollout over continuous network-adjustment action trajectories, providing operators with an explorable counterfactual simulation environment for network planning and optimization. Extensive experiments on variable-parameter mobile traffic data covering 31,900 cells across 9 districts demonstrate that MobiWM achieves the best distributional fidelity across all evaluation scenarios, significantly outperforming existing traffic prediction baselines and representative world models. A downstream RL-based case study further validates MobiWM as a simulation environment for network optimization, establishing a new paradigm for digital twin-driven wireless network management.

title: Towards Improving the External Validity of Software Engineering Experiments with Transportability Methods
summary: Controlled experiments are a core research method in software engineering (SE) for validating causal claims. However, recruiting a sample of participants that represents the intended target population is often difficult or expensive, which limits the external validity of experimental results. At the same time, SE researchers often have access to much larger amounts of observational than experimental data (e.g., from repositories, issue trackers, logs, surveys and industrial processes). Transportability methods combine these data from experimental and observational studies to "transport" results from the experimental sample to a broader, more representative sample of the target population. Although the ability to combine observational and experimental data in a principled way could substantially benefit empirical SE research, transportability methods have - to our knowledge - not been adopted in SE. In this vision, we aim to help make that adoption possible. To that end, we introduce transportability methods, their prerequisites, and demonstrate their potential through a simulation. We then outline several SE research scenarios in which these methods could apply, e.g., how to effectively use students as substitutes for developers. Finally, we outline a road map and practical guidelines to support SE researchers in applying them. Adopting transportability methods in SE research can strengthen the external validity of controlled experiments and help the field produce results that are both more reliable and more useful in practice.

title: MedVR: Annotation-Free Medical Visual Reasoning via Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold immense promise for complex clinical tasks, but their reasoning capabilities are often constrained by text-only paradigms that fail to ground inferences in visual evidence. This limitation not only curtails performance on tasks requiring fine-grained visual analysis but also introduces risks of visual hallucination in safety-critical applications. Thus, we introduce MedVR, a novel reinforcement learning framework that enables annotation-free visual reasoning for medical VLMs. Its core innovation lies in two synergistic mechanisms: Entropy-guided Visual Regrounding (EVR) uses model uncertainty to direct exploration, while Consensus-based Credit Assignment (CCA) distills pseudo-supervision from rollout agreement. Without any human annotations for intermediate steps, MedVR achieves state-of-the-art performance on diverse public medical VQA benchmarks, significantly outperforming existing models. By learning to reason directly with visual evidence, MedVR promotes the robustness and transparency essential for accelerating the clinical deployment of medical AI.

title: Introducing Echo Networks for Computational Neuroevolution
comments: Accepted for AMLDS 2026 (International Conference on Advanced Machine Learning and Data Science)
summary: For applications on the extreme edge, minimal networks of only a few dozen artificial neurons for event detection and classification in discrete time signals would be highly desirable. Feed-forward networks, RNNs, and CNNs evolved through evolutionary algorithms can all be successful in this respect but pose the problem of allowing little systematicity in mutation and recombination if the standard direct genetic encoding of the weights is used (as for instance in the classic NEAT algorithm). We therefore introduce Echo Networks, a type of recurrent network that consists of the connection matrix only, with the source neurons of the synapses represented as rows, destination neurons as columns and weights as entries. There are no layers, and connections between neurons can be bidirectional but are technically all recurrent. Input and output can be arbitrarily assigned to any of the neurons and only use an additional (optional) function in their computational path, e.g., a sigmoid to obtain a binary classification output. We evaluated Echo Networks successfully on the classification of electrocardiography signals but see the most promising potential in their genome representation as a single matrix, allowing matrix computations and factorisations as mutation and recombination operators.

title: Competitive Transaction Admission in PCNs: Online Knapsack with Positive and Negative Items
summary:
Payment channel networks (PCNs) are a promising solution to make cryptocurrency transactions faster and more scalable. At their core, PCNs bypass the blockchain by routing the transactions through intermediary channels. However, a channel can forward a transaction only if it possesses the necessary funds: the problem of keeping the channels balanced is a current bottleneck on the PCN's transaction throughput.
  This paper considers the problem of maximizing the number of accepted transactions by a channel in a PCN. Previous works either considered the associated optimization problem with all transactions known in advance or developed heuristics tested on particular transaction datasets. This work however considers the problem in its purely online form where the transactions are arbitrary and revealed one after the other.
  We show that the problem can be modeled as a new online knapsack variant where the items (transaction proposals) can be either positive or negative depending on the direction of the transaction. The main contribution of this paper is a deterministic online algorithm that is $O(\log B)$-competitive, where $B$ is the knapsack capacity (initially allocated funds). We complement this result with an asymptotically matching lower bound of $Ω(\log B)$ which holds for any randomized algorithm, demonstrating our algorithm's optimality.

title: "Theater of Mind" for LLMs: A Cognitive Architecture Based on Global Workspace Theory
summary: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) operate fundamentally as Bounded-Input Bounded-Output (BIBO) systems. They remain in a passive state until explicitly prompted, computing localized responses without intrinsic temporal continuity. While effective for isolated tasks, this reactive paradigm presents a critical bottleneck for engineering autonomous artificial intelligence. Current multi-agent frameworks attempt to distribute cognitive load but frequently rely on static memory pools and passive message passing, which inevitably leads to cognitive stagnation and homogeneous deadlocks during extended execution. To address this structural limitation, we propose Global Workspace Agents (GWA), a cognitive architecture inspired by Global Workspace Theory. GWA transitions multi-agent coordination from a passive data structure to an active, event-driven discrete dynamical system. By coupling a central broadcast hub with a heterogeneous swarm of functionally constrained agents, the system maintains a continuous cognitive cycle. Furthermore, we introduce an entropy-based intrinsic drive mechanism that mathematically quantifies semantic diversity, dynamically regulating generation temperature to autonomously break reasoning deadlocks. Coupled with a dual-layer memory bifurcation strategy to ensure long-term cognitive continuity, GWA provides a robust, reproducible engineering framework for sustained, self-directed LLM agency.

title: Empirical Evaluation of Taxonomic Trace Links: A Case Study
summary: Context: Traceability is a key quality attribute of artifacts that are used in knowledge-intensive tasks and supports software engineers in producing higher-quality software. Despite its clear benefits, traceability is often neglected in practice due to challenges such as granularity of traces, lack of a common artifact structure, and unclear responsibility. The Taxonomic Trace Links (TTL) approach connects source and target artifacts through a domain-specific taxonomy, aiming to address these common traceability challenges. Objective: In this study, we empirically evaluate TTL in an industrial setting to identify its strengths and weaknesses for real-world adoption. Method: We conducted a mixed-methods study at Ericsson involving one of its software products. Quantitative and qualitative data were collected across two traceability use cases. We established trace links between 463 business use cases, 64 test cases, and 277 ISO-standard requirements. Additionally, we held three focus group sessions with practitioners. Results: We identified two practically relevant scenarios where traceability is required and evaluated TTL in each. Overall, practitioners found TTL to be a useful solution for one of the scenarios, while less useful for the other. However, developing a domain-specific taxonomy and managing heterogeneous artifact structures were noted as significant challenges. Moreover, the precision of the classifier that is used to create trace links needs to be improved to make the solution practical. Conclusion: TTL is a promising approach that can be adopted in practice and enables traceability use cases. However, TTL is not a replacement for traditional trace links, but rather complements them to enable more traceability use cases and encourage the early creation of trace links.

title: OmniJigsaw: Enhancing Omni-Modal Reasoning via Modality-Orchestrated Reordering
summary: To extend the reinforcement learning post-training paradigm to omni-modal models for concurrently bolstering video-audio understanding and collaborative reasoning, we propose OmniJigsaw, a generic self-supervised framework built upon a temporal reordering proxy task. Centered on the chronological reconstruction of shuffled audio-visual clips, this paradigm strategically orchestrates visual and auditory signals to compel cross-modal integration through three distinct strategies: Joint Modality Integration, Sample-level Modality Selection, and Clip-level Modality Masking. Recognizing that the efficacy of such proxy tasks is fundamentally tied to puzzle quality, we design a two-stage coarse-to-fine data filtering pipeline, which facilitates the efficient adaptation of OmniJigsaw to massive unannotated omni-modal data. Our analysis reveals a ``bi-modal shortcut phenomenon'' in joint modality integration and demonstrates that fine-grained clip-level modality masking mitigates this issue while outperforming sample-level modality selection. Extensive evaluations on 15 benchmarks show substantial gains in video, audio, and collaborative reasoning, validating OmniJigsaw as a scalable paradigm for self-supervised omni-modal learning.

title: SciFigDetect: A Benchmark for AI-Generated Scientific Figure Detection
summary: Modern multimodal generators can now produce scientific figures at near-publishable quality, creating a new challenge for visual forensics and research integrity. Unlike conventional AI-generated natural images, scientific figures are structured, text-dense, and tightly aligned with scholarly semantics, making them a distinct and difficult detection target. However, existing AI-generated image detection benchmarks and methods are almost entirely developed for open-domain imagery, leaving this setting largely unexplored. We present the first benchmark for AI-generated scientific figure detection. To construct it, we develop an agent-based data pipeline that retrieves licensed source papers, performs multimodal understanding of paper text and figures, builds structured prompts, synthesizes candidate figures, and filters them through a review-driven refinement loop. The resulting benchmark covers multiple figure categories, multiple generation sources and aligned real--synthetic pairs. We benchmark representative detectors under zero-shot, cross-generator, and degraded-image settings. Results show that current methods fail dramatically in zero-shot transfer, exhibit strong generator-specific overfitting, and remain fragile under common post-processing corruptions. These findings reveal a substantial gap between existing AIGI detection capabilities and the emerging distribution of high-quality scientific figures. We hope this benchmark can serve as a foundation for future research on robust and generalizable scientific-figure forensics. The dataset is available at https://github.com/Joyce-yoyo/SciFigDetect.

title: Vision-Language Foundation Models for Comprehensive Automated Pavement Condition Assessment
summary: General-purpose vision-language models demonstrate strong performance in everyday domains but struggle with specialized technical fields requiring precise terminology, structured reasoning, and adherence to engineering standards. This work addresses whether domain-specific instruction tuning can enable comprehensive pavement condition assessment through vision-language models. PaveInstruct, a dataset containing 278,889 image-instruction-response pairs spanning 32 task types, was created by unifying annotations from nine heterogeneous pavement datasets. PaveGPT, a pavement foundation model trained on this dataset, was evaluated against state-of-the-art vision-language models across perception, understanding, and reasoning tasks. Instruction tuning transformed model capabilities, achieving improvements exceeding 20% in spatial grounding, reasoning, and generation tasks while producing ASTM D6433-compliant outputs. These results enable transportation agencies to deploy unified conversational assessment tools that replace multiple specialized systems, simplifying workflows and reducing technical expertise requirements. The approach establishes a pathway for developing instruction-driven AI systems across infrastructure domains including bridge inspection, railway maintenance, and building condition assessment.

title: EditCaption: Human-Aligned Instruction Synthesis for Image Editing via Supervised Fine-Tuning and Direct Preference Optimization
summary: High-quality training triplets (source-target image pairs with precise editing instructions) are a critical bottleneck for scaling instruction-guided image editing models. Vision-language models (VLMs) are widely used for automated instruction synthesis, but we identify three systematic failure modes in image-pair settings: orientation inconsistency (e.g., left/right confusion), viewpoint ambiguity, and insufficient fine-grained attribute description. Human evaluation shows that over 47% of instructions from strong baseline VLMs contain critical errors unusable for downstream training. We propose EditCaption, a scalable two-stage post-training pipeline for VLM-based instruction synthesis. Stage 1 builds a 100K supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset by combining GLM automatic annotation, EditScore-based filtering, and human refinement for spatial, directional, and attribute-level accuracy. Stage 2 collects 10K human preference pairs targeting the three failure modes and applies direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment beyond SFT alone. On Eval-400, ByteMorph-Bench, and HQ-Edit, fine-tuned Qwen3-VL models outperform open-source baselines; the 235B model reaches 4.712 on Eval-400 (vs. Gemini-3-Pro 4.706, GPT-4.1 4.220, Kimi-K2.5 4.111) and 4.588 on ByteMorph-Bench (vs. Gemini-3-Pro 4.522, GPT-4.1 3.412). Human evaluation shows critical errors falling from 47.75% to 23% and correctness rising from 41.75% to 66%. The work offers a practical path to scalable, human-aligned instruction synthesis for image editing data.

title: Quantum Integrated Communication and Computing Over Multiple-Access Bosonic Channel
summary: We investigate a quantum integrated communication and computation (QICC) scheme for a single-mode bosonic multiple-access channel (MAC) with coherent-state signalling. By exploiting the natural superposition property of the quantum MAC, a common receiver simultaneously performs over-the-air computation (OAC) on the analogue symbols transmitted by one set of devices and decodes multiple-access data from another. The joint design of the transmit power control and the receive coefficient leads to a non-convex optimization problem that maximizes computation accuracy under a prescribed sum-rate communication constraint. To address this challenge, we develop a low-complexity alternating-optimization framework that incorporates: (i) closed-form linear minimum-mean square error updates for the receive coefficient, (ii) monotonicity properties of the quantum sum-rate constraint, and (iii) projected-gradient refinements for the communication powers. The proposed QICC scheme achieves an effective computation-communication trade-off with fast convergence and low computational complexity.
